SELECT
                        COUNT(*) AS total_requests,
                        COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS unique_users
                    FROM audit_logs

SELECT
                        AVG(CASE WHEN detail->>'success' = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                            AS success_rate,
                        AVG((detail->>'execution_time_ms')::float)
                            AS avg_execution_time_ms
                    FROM audit_logs
                    WHERE event_type = 'query_execution'

SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS count
                    FROM audit_logs
                    WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
                    GROUP BY user_id
                    ORDER BY count DESC
                    LIMIT 10

SELECT tbl, COUNT(*) AS count
                        FROM audit_logs,
                             jsonb_array_elements_text(
                                 CASE
                                     WHEN detail ? 'target_tables'
                                          AND jsonb_typeof(detail->'target_tables') = 'array'
                                     THEN detail->'target_tables'
                                     ELSE '[]'::jsonb
                                 END
                             ) AS tbl
                        GROUP BY tbl
                        ORDER BY count DESC
                        LIMIT 10

SELECT

                        COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS unique_users
                    FROM audit_logs
